missions.name: IM-1 Odysseus (Intuitive Machines)
missions.endedReason: Entered standby mode on 29 February 2024, awaiting the next lunar day; the sources used report no revival.

missions.name: IM-2 Athena (Intuitive Machines)
missions.endedReason: Early end of mission after landing on its side in a crater; batteries were depleted.

missions.name: Chandrayaan-3 Vikram (ISRO)
missions.endedReason: Lander set into sleep mode before the lunar night; ISRO awaited a wake-up around 22 September 2023.
